readerContract.humanQuestion: Does the Windows app do anything different from Gemini in a browser, who can use it, and what permissions or features depend on the account?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Decide whether the Windows shortcut is useful without assuming Gemini can automatically read a screen or files, or that every feature is included.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: Reader may know Gemini as a browser tool and may not know desktop, account, admin or subscription conditions.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: The Windows app is another doorway to Gemini: Alt + Space changes how quickly it opens, while uploads and Google-app connections remain choices and some capabilities have separate conditions.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A reader revising a volunteer email can open Gemini beside the draft, decide what text to paste, and keep the date and request unchanged.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A short dated NewsStand explainer of the September 10 Windows release, not a performance test or automation promise.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I know whether this saves a step for me, what account conditions apply, and what I still choose to share.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: The Windows app is a faster desktop route into Gemini. It can be convenient while accounts, administrators and deliberate connections still set its scope.
causalSequence: Google released the Windows app and Alt + Space shortcut.
A reader opens Gemini beside the task rather than in a browser tab.
The reader chooses any image upload or connected Google app.
Account and administrator controls can still limit use.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A reader pastes a school-volunteer email and asks for a warmer version that leaves the date and request unchanged.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A managed work account may not expose the app if its administrator has not enabled Gemini.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose the route that is convenient, check account and administrator eligibility, and decide what information to share.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; The LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes; Sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Answer browser-versus-app first; use selected uploads and connections as the concrete boundary rather than generic advice.
